source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Go through the test records and enter which items are failing.
3. Create your certificate; insert the right failures.

If you don't follow the steps then you are at risk of wasting time by double entering. After creating your report, go back to the main screen and check to ensure appliance failures are updated, otherwise you will have double entered the data and you will be liable for paying for the double data entry.

When creating the certificate, you have to manually select each failure as none are pre-selected. You shouldn't rely on the failures shown to be accurate and comprehensive.

## PAT Test Records / Mobile App: Where to document failed electrical appliance safety checks

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| Fail cause | Yes/No |
| Insulated parts | Insulated parts; used for class 1 appliances only - not for class 2 and class 3 |
| Faulty |
